query:
MATCH (a:Buyer)-[:AWARDS]-(c:Award)
WHERE toLower(coalesce(c.procedure, c.title, "")) CONTAINS "direct award"
WITH a, count(c) AS total

UNWIND topAuthorities AS auth
MATCH path=(auth)-[:AWARDS]->(c:Award)
RETURN path

question: 1α. Απευθείας αναθέσεις > 30.000€ (εκτός εξαιρούμενων CPV)

query: MATCH (a:Buyer)-[:AWARDS]->(c:Award)-[:WON_BY]->(co:Winner), (c)-[:HAS_CPV]->(cpv:CPV)-[:USE_THRESHOLD]->(t:Threshold) WHERE c.submission_date.year = toInteger($year) WITH a, co, cpv, t, sum(c.value) as total_value, collect(c.identifier) as contracts WHERE total_value > t.value AND size(contracts) > 1 RETURN a.name as αναθέτουσα, co.name as ανάδοχος, cpv.code as CPV, total_value as συνολικό_ποσό, t.value as όριο, contracts as συμβάσεις ORDER BY total_value DESC
